My projects

Sentinel

Monitoring station

Sentinel checks a room for temperature, humidity, movement, fire and gas. You can see everything live on a website.

How it works

  1. A DHT11 measures temperature and humidity. A PIR sensor sees movement. A flame sensor and an MQ-2 look for fire and gas.
  2. The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi reads all the sensors.
  3. It sends the numbers to Arduino IoT Cloud over WiFi.
  4. My dashboard, made with Lovable, shows them live.

Made with

  • Arduino UNO R4 WiFi
  • C++
  • Arduino IoT Cloud
  • DHT11, PIR, MQ-2, flame sensor
  • Lovable

Door alarm

Alarm

If someone walks through the door, the buzzer goes off.

How it works

  1. The PIR sensor watches the doorway and notices when something warm moves.
  2. The Arduino keeps checking the sensor.
  3. When it sees movement, it turns the buzzer on.

Made with

  • Arduino UNO R4 WiFi
  • C++
  • PIR motion sensor
  • Buzzer
  • Breadboard

Distance meter

Distance sensor

It measures how far away something is using sound, and shows the number on a screen.

How it works

  1. The HC-SR04 sends out a sound that is too high for us to hear.
  2. The sound bounces back and the Arduino times how long that takes.
  3. The code turns that time into centimetres.
  4. The distance shows up on the LCD screen.

Made with

  • Arduino UNO R4 WiFi
  • C++
  • HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
  • 16x2 LCD display
